description: Create a key result under an objective. Set direction to "down" for measures that must FALL (cost, latency, days-to-live) or attainment reads improvement as failure. Without a baseline AND a target the measure cannot be scored and reports as not-measured rather than 0%. Set derivedMetric to have AnyForge compute it instead of a person entering readings. Requires `write` scope.

baseline.description: Where we started: { value, asOf (ISO yyyy-mm-dd), source }.

current.description: Latest reading: { value, asOf, source }. Entered measures only — ignored for derived ones.

derivedMetric.description: Required when sourceKind is "derived": initiatives_with_owner_pct | initiatives_on_time_pct.

ownerUid.description: The one person who owns this number.

name: anyforge_create_key_result
title: Create key result
